item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 15/Apr/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A southerly airstream will bring hot weather to the coastal areas of Guangdong persistently in the next few days. With the anticyclone aloft now affecting Guangdong weakening gradually, there will be a few showers over the region in the middle and latter parts of this week. A trough of low pressure is expected to bring thundery showers to southern China over the weekend and early next week.
